problem: Sebagai project planner, susun model Transportation model untuk capacity decision: decide whether available capacity is sufficient under constraints. Data utama: demand vector=[53, 60, 96, 114], capacity vector=[60, 172, 71, 80], unit-cost vector=[25, 20, 30, 39], target=563 work package. Tambahkan minimal dua constraints, selesaikan/analisis model, lalu jelaskan keputusan dan satu sensitivity check.

constraints: Check unit, magnitude, feasibility terhadap constraints, dan consistency dengan context.
